approvalRequired: Separate approval after company-domain authentication, contacts and customer notification scope pass launch acceptance

authentication: Dedicated production CRON_SECRET bearer token, at least 32 characters

configuration.edge.STACKENDBOX_PRODUCTION_CRON_SECRET: Secure value shared only with the production Worker CRON_SECRET
configuration.edge.STACKENDBOX_PRODUCTION_PORTAL_JOB_C: Explicit approved client UUIDs for the initial rollout. Expand only after reviewing dispatch evidence.
configuration.candidateProtection: productionConfiguration forces jobs disabled on the workers.dev candidate even if its switch is accidentally set

allowedActions: Read registrar details for up to four already assigned domains per run
Save independently verified snapshots without erasing previous records on provider failure
Queue reminder stages at 60, 30, 14, 7 and 1 days
Dispatch up to four authorized client emails from the existing dedicated portal Brevo integration
Save job, reconciliation and notification audit events
forbiddenActions: Change a provider-confirmed expiration based on payment alone
Use the public website Brevo key

deduplication.reminders: Unique outbox key includes domain, verified expiry, reminder stage and recipient
deduplication.dispatch: Atomic claim with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
deduplication.recipient: Claim checks active client membership and approved email
deduplication.staleClaims: Reviewed claim recovery runs before dispatch
deduplication.ambiguousProviderSend: review_required. Never blindly resend after a timeout or missing confirmation.
deduplication.knownPredispatchFailure: Existing narrow recovery RPC only covers the verified missing-sender failure. Other cases require provider evidence.

capacityBounds.note: Four-message batches suit staged onboarding and advance reminders. This is not an instant-delivery guarantee for a simultaneous 400-message burst. Verify actual usage after activation.

failureHandling.worker: Throws on disabled, failed, malformed or timed-out backend execution. Observe existing Worker errors.
failureHandling.backend: Keeps per-email review status, provider reconciliation flags and immutable audit events visible in Admin Operations/Health.
failureHandling.providerRetry: Failed read reconciliation becomes eligible after one hour, while successful reads are due after 24 hours.
failureHandling.alerts: Worker errors and Admin Operations provide operational evidence. A proactive founder alert channel must be selected and tested before claiming automatic notification of failures.
failureHandling.backup: Independent GitHub Actions schedule and protected backup environment remain active. Preserve completed generations and verify account-level GitHub Actions failure notifications separately.

activationChecks: Confirm approved client scope, portal sender and company-domain callback URLs
Set the dedicated matching job secret through secure provider tools
Enable only the approved production profile and proposed cron entries
Observe a real scheduled run and its database audit
Verify one authorized dispatch and duplicate-run behavior
Verify a controlled failure alert with no real registrar mutation
Keep all financial and registrar execution flags false
rollback: Remove production cron entries and set both job switches false. Preserve outbox, audit and reconciliation history. Never delete queued or accepted customer notifications to roll back scheduling.
